description.value:
Frequency once per day

Traits Paradise-Touched

The first time each day that a Signal-declared effect of yours fails, you gain no Signal Drift from it. This is not optional and applies to the first failure whether or not you wanted to spend it there. You still take the force damage in full. Paradise registers the flinch; the GM may make something of that.

cinderfall.incomplete: Once/day, the first Signal failure grants no Signal Drift (full damage still applies). Waives 1 real, tracked Drift point riding on the unbuildable Signal/Drift mechanic. The class's Signal/Static core mechanic has no rule-element analog anywhere in pf2e-source: `AdjustDegreeOfSuccess` evaluates in `beforePrepareData`, before the roll resolves, so it cannot hook a GM's own secret post-roll check or show the player a value other than what was actually computed (`pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/adjust-degree-of-success.ts`); self-inflicted reactive damage/resource cost keyed to the resolving effect's own degree of success has no rule-element home; and no `Reroll` rule-element key exists anywhere in the compendium (`pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/human/level-1/courteous-comeback.json` ships `rules: []`). The 0-10 Signal Drift track has the same absence as Bandwidth: no `SpecialResource`/counter representation anywhere in the corpus.
